content.comment_body: Good evening. I have a two-phase pulse generator (rotary encoder) with channels A and B. I want to activate one output for clockwise direction and another for counterclockwise direction. The maximum frequency at the [product_name] input is stated as 6000Hz or 6kHz. Can anyone assist with this? Thank you.
The fast inputs on [product_name] support up to 5kHz, not 6kHz. Also, this device is not well-suited for working with A/B encoders.

analysis.insight_summary: The user asks about controlling outputs based on rotation direction using a two-phase rotary encoder and [product_name]. Another user clarifies the frequency limitation and indicates the device is not suitable for A/B encoders. This highlights a gap between the hardware's capabilities and the user's requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates [product_name] will fully support A/B encoders, accurately detect rotation direction, and handle input frequencies of 6kHz or higher.
